HOME.title: BOSS TILL THE END
HOME.description: This time you’re not the hero.

CARD2.title: Visual style
CARD2.text: Two worlds. Two styles. Inside the game, a retrofuturistic pixel art world. Outside, a hand-drawn comic-style reality.

CARD3.title: Narrative
CARD3.text: As the final boss of a video game, every encounter becomes a window into the unexpected lives of the players who cross your path.

USP.title: The game essence
USP.description: Boss Till the End is built around an unusual perspective: playing from the role of the final boss. Players face waves of enemies trying to “beat the game”, while making decisions that shape six different storylines and alter the narrative path of each run.
USP.description2: All of this is presented through a retrofuturistic visual universe that blends pixel art with hand-drawn line art, reinforcing the contrast between the game and the world surrounding it.

CURRENTSTATE.title: Current development status
CURRENTSTATE.description: Boss Till the End is currently in an early stage of development. The team is working on a playable prototype designed to clearly convey the tone, feel, and core experience of the game. This prototype will serve as the foundation for validating the game’s mechanics, narrative, and artistic direction before moving into the next stages of production.

CAROUSEL.title: Initial drafts
CAROUSEL.description: A selection of early sketches that helped shape the idea and tone of the game.

TEAM.title: Our team
TEAM.description: Boss Till the End is being developed by a small independent team with complementary backgrounds in design, art, and development, supported by a structured approach to planning and project execution. We work collaboratively, combining a clear creative vision with an organized and sustainable development process.

MOREINFO.text1: You play from the role of the final boss of a video game. As enemies try to advance and “beat the game”, your goal is to stop them and hold control from the other side of the screen.
MOREINFO.text2: Every encounter is also a window into the lives of the players who challenge you. Through your decisions, you influence six different stories, shaping their narrative paths and how they intersect with your role as the boss.
MOREINFO.text3: Your decisions shape four different storylines. The choices you make alter their narrative paths and how they intersect with your role as the boss
MOREINFO.text4: The game unfolds in a retrofuturistic pixel art world. Outside of it, a hand-drawn line art style reveals the reality behind the characters.
